query: UPDATE agent_preview_lease l SET status = CASE WHEN l.expires_at <= now() THEN 'expired' ELSE 'offline' END WHERE status IN ('starting','ready') AND (l.expires_at <= now() OR (replica_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_preview_replica r WHERE r.id = l.replica_id AND r.expires_at > now()))) RETURNING metadata AS "metadata: Json<StoredPreview>", replica_id, status
